name: Portworx by Everpure
summary:
Portworx by Everpure provides cloud-native storage, data protection, and Kubernetes data platform technologies for enterprise infrastructure environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate Portworx environments across secure Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms. From persistent storage and disaster recovery through to platform resilience and operational governance, we help teams create scalable, reliable, and operationally consistent cloud-native environments.
overview:
Portworx by Everpure supports modern cloud-native infrastructure and enterprise Kubernetes operations through scalable storage, data protection, and platform resilience solutions.

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate Portworx environments across cloud, hybrid, and enterprise Kubernetes infrastructure. From persistent Kubernetes storage and data services through to disaster recovery, automation, and operational governance, we help teams create environments that are secure, resilient, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building reliable Kubernetes platform foundations that support long-term operational scalability and resilience. This includes storage automation, observability, lifecycle management, disaster recovery, platform resilience, and operational enablement across complex cloud-native environments.

We help organisations improve data availability, reduce operational risk, and operate Kubernetes platforms with confidence.
